source_review.notes: Checked seven official or primary project sources. Current LLVM documentation describes libFuzzer as an in-process coverage-guided evolutionary engine using SanitizerCoverage and notes its maintenance status. Google fuzzing guidance covers sanitizers, untrusted-input targets, seed corpora, structure-aware approaches and target quality. Current Hypothesis documentation describes stateful sequence generation, shrinking and failure replay. Current OWASP guidance covers fuzzing and unrestricted resource consumption. Tool mechanisms remain examples; targets, generators, oracles, safety, triage and governance are explicit local responsibilities.

evidence: Checked input space X, valid set V, defect-triggering set F, generator distribution q, target observation T(x), oracle O, executions n and per-execution mass p=q(F).
Checked subset, probability-mass, conditional discovery and complement notation.
Confirmed independence is explicitly labeled an approximation and guided search can change q across executions.
notation_and_syntax.notes: The model estimates search discovery under a stated distribution; it never proves robustness over the complete input/sequence space.

evidence: Recomputed p=10^-6 and n=1,000,000 as 1-(1-p)^n approximately 1-e^-1 = 63.2%.
Solved 1-(1-10^-6)^n at least 0.95 as n at least ln(0.05)/ln(0.999999), approximately 2,995,731.
Checked the illustrative 20% malformed lane and 99.9% early-rejection cases as scenario values.
Confirmed all ten examples and five exercise/answer pairs are distinct.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The discovery values assume fixed independent probability; real adaptive, correlated campaigns need empirical analysis.

evidence: Derived discovery probability as the complement of n independent misses.
Verified that increasing probability of satisfying a valid prefix raises deep-target reachability while a separate malformed lane preserves parser cases.
Constructed unauthorized wrong-success behavior and confirmed a crash-only oracle cannot detect it.
Verified a shrink is a reproducer only when equivalent state/build and the same oracle/root cause persist.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Search, correctness, and minimization claims are deliberately separated.

evidence: Reviewed library/parser, service listener, gateway/direct, database/broker/stateful and distributed targets with real versus simulated dependencies.
Reviewed valid, near-valid, invalid, ambiguous, duplicate, reordered, truncated, oversized, compressed, Unicode/binary, recursive, cross-field, identity, sequence and concurrent cases.
Reviewed HTTP framing/normalization, JSON duplicates/numbers/Unicode, Protobuf/gRPC frames/unknowns/streams, GraphQL grammar/cost, and events/webhooks keys/replay/signatures/poison messages.

Reviewed crash/undefined behavior, wrong success/error, authorization/state/effect, differential/metamorphic, CPU/memory/time/output/amplification, nondeterminism, shrinking drift, corpus secrets/PII, worker isolation, disclosure, remediation and continuous operation.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Coverage spans syntax, structure, semantics, state, identity, protocols, intermediaries, resources, concurrency, evidence security and lifecycle.

evidence: Confirmed harnesses reach the real target, preserve relevant production behavior, reset/isolate state and bound input/actions/resources/output/network/effects.
Confirmed generator diversity and deep reachability coexist with malformed-wire coverage and rejection-stage measurement.
Confirmed oracles cover protocol/domain/security/resource correctness beyond crashes and coverage remains search feedback only.
Confirmed exact provenance, stable reproduction, semantics-preserving minimization, root-cause triage, secret-safe corpora, durable fixes/regressions and continuous campaigns.
invariant_checking.notes: No-finding outcomes require harness, generator, oracle, instrumentation and budget validation before interpretation.

evidence: Reviewed discovery-probability derivation and its independence limitation.
Reviewed structure-reachability argument and preservation of malformed cases.
Reviewed wrong-success counterexample and confirmed crash freedom is insufficient.
Reviewed shrink-preservation argument and confirmed textual smallness alone is insufficient.
proof_review.notes: Formal arguments bound interpretation; actual discovery probability, depth, resource behavior and exploitability require empirical evidence.

evidence: Confirmed formal passages are labeled discovery derivation, structure reachability argument, wrong-success counterexample and shrink-preservation argument.
Confirmed LLVM, Google fuzzing, Hypothesis and OWASP claims remain scoped to cited sources.
Confirmed target selection, generator allocation, resource budgets, normalization, corpus retention, severity and campaign policy are local engineering choices.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Tool mechanisms, mathematical intuition, correctness claims and operating policy remain separate.

evidence: All seven official or primary references were checked on 2026-09-02 where current documentation applies.

The chapter requires exact build/config/tool/instrumentation/corpus/seed/environment evidence, executions/depth/rejection/coverage/resource measurements, stable reproducers, root-cause triage, remediation/regression and escaped-incident review.
No production API's robustness, coverage, vulnerability count, discovery probability, resource safety or exploit resistance is asserted.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Worked examples and probability calculations are illustrative, not deployed campaign evidence.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed surface selection, harness fidelity/safety, layered generation, feedback, crash/protocol/domain/security/metamorphic/differential/resource oracles, stateful models, protocol edges, shrinking/reproduction, secure triage, continuous operation and honest measurement as one robustness discipline.

practitioner_review.notes: Checked implementability through narrow real targets, seed/dictionary and structured generators, malformed lanes, coverage/domain feedback, sanitizers, bounded isolated workers, state models, exact sequences/seeds, authoritative state/effect oracles, corpus/reproducer separation, root-cause clustering, secret scanning, regression seeds, CI and continuous campaigns, mutation audits and measured rejection/depth.

pedagogical_review.notes: The module progresses from surface and harness through generation, feedback, oracles, state, protocols, shrinking, triage and metrics. Counterexamples expose random-equals-fuzzing, schema-valid-equals-robust, crash-free-equals-correct, coverage-equals-proof and minimized-equals-same-bug shortcuts. Ten examples and five progressive exercises have complete answers.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external fuzzer/tool vendor, security researcher, standards body, API team, platform, or practitioner review is claimed.
